evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story requests creating a new game with name/description; unique goal and context.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific mechanism (inviting via URL) and goal.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: This specifies starting a round with a specific input method; no other story specifies the same.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-focused view of all items in session; no other story duplicates moderator's view requirement.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: PP-013 expresses the same requirement (re-estimating a previously estimated story) with the same actor and goal; no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding a new single item is distinct from bulk import/copy mechanisms; no other story duplicates this exact need.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing an item is a distinct capability (modify existing items); no other story duplicates it.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deletion is a distinct action; no other story expresses the same requirement.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: This allows the moderator to reveal estimates early, which is different from controlled simultaneous reveal; no other story duplicates this.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting the average is a distinct decision rule; no other story states the same acceptance behavior.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic filling on unanimous card is a specific automation requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate is distinct from automated/selection behaviors; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: This duplicates PP-005's capability (re-estimating/selecting an item to be re-estimated) with same actor and goal; no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing as a file/process is a specific bulk-entry mechanism distinct from copy/paste; treated as unique.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a different UI affordance for bulk entry than an import feature; not considered a duplicate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing games (finding previous game) is different from viewing a transcript or scrolling within a session; unique.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript is a distinct readout/export-type feature; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export to HTML is a specific format export requirement distinct from CSV or viewing; unique.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export to CSV is a distinct format export requirement; not a duplicate of other export/view stories.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a whole game (and its stories/estimates) is a distinct maintenance action; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: create an account for the application by entering my name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is distinct from other account operations and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is a distinct authentication requirement; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account update is a separate capability; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display preference is unique; no other story requests the same feature.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, etc.} or {0, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, etc.}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting a card set (sequence) is a distinct configuration feature; no duplicate.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Specifying an invite limit is a unique constraint not found elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Joining via received URL as an estimator is distinct from inviting or account creation; unique.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Participant visibility of the current item is distinct and not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator-focused view of upcoming items differs from moderator views and other story history features; unique.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Immediate indicator that an estimator has submitted is distinct from seeing estimates themselves; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simultaneous reveal after all have played is different from moderator-controlled early reveal; unique.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: This is functionally the same as PP-041 (change while draw not completed) with the same actor and condition; no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates history per estimator is a unique analytics/history requirement; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Seeing identity-to-estimate mapping in current round is distinct from immediate indicator or prior-estimates history; unique.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Ability to start a visible timer is a unique feature; no other story duplicates it.

evaluations.evidence: have the two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset behavior for the timer is a specific automation distinct from the start-timer story.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: In-session scroll-back through prior rounds is distinct from browsing previous games or viewing transcripts; unique.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering persistence is a unique UI expectation not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: This duplicates PP-034's requirement (change until draw completion); same actor, context and goal without meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail/avatar display is a distinct personalization feature; no duplicate found.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a specific developer-level quality goal different from browser support; unique.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Providing a glossary is a unique documentation requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing is a distinct technical requirement; no duplicate in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific browser compatibility targets are different from general standards/accessibility goals; unique.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct quality requirement; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance/responsiveness is a unique non-functional requirement; no duplicates.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a distinct internationalization requirement; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL structure expectation is a unique usability requirement; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Custom error pages are a distinct UX requirement; no duplicate stories.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized data storage for research is a unique privacy requirement; not duplicated.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Usage metrics for monitoring are a distinct stakeholder request; no duplicate.
